data.description: ## Testing Mode GREEN ## Overview Insert the entry and exit validator invocation blocks into sprint SKILL.md. Makes T5's RED tests pass. Entry check reads upstream implementation-plan PRECONDITIONS; exit write emits sprint's own PRECONDITIONS. ## File Impact - Modify: plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md ## Implementation Notes **Entry section** — insert after Config Resolution / Migration Check sections: ```bash # Stage-boundary preconditions entry check (Story 4) source "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/lib/preconditions-validator-lib.sh" _dso_pv_entry_check "sprint" "implementation-plan" "${EPIC_ID}" || true # Fail-open: diagnostic emitted on missing/invalid upstream PRECONDITIONS; skill proceeds ``` **Exit section** — insert just before P8 (Completion) SKILL_EXIT breadcrumb or STATUS emission: ```bash # Stage-boundary preconditions exit write (Story 4) _dso_pv_exit_write "sprint" "${_UPSTREAM_EVENT_ID:-}" "${_SPRINT_SPEC_HASH:-}" "${EPIC_ID}" || true ``` Both fail-open (|| true). Zero user interaction. ## Acceptance Criteria - [ ] All 4 tests from T5 PASS after this edit   Verify: bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/skills/test-preconditions-sprint-validator.sh 2>&1 | grep -v FAIL | grep -q "pass\|ok\|PASS" - [ ] Entry section references _dso_pv_entry_check with "sprint" and "implementation-plan"   Verify: grep -q '_dso_pv_entry_check.*sprint.*implementation-plan\|_dso_pv_entry_check.*"sprint"' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md - [ ] Exit section references _dso_pv_exit_write with "sprint"   Verify: grep -q '_dso_pv_exit_write.*sprint' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md - [ ] check-referential-integrity.sh passes   Verify: bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/scripts/check-referential-integrity.sh 2>&1 | grep -v "^$" | tail -1 | grep -qi "ok\|pass\|0 errors" - [ ] validate.sh --ci passes   Verify: bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/scripts/validate.sh --ci ## Retry Budget MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model) On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: Add preconditions-validator-lib entry/exit hooks to sprint SKILL.md
